note_reply: There was no note from ownership this week, and I want to say for the record — not because anyone asked, but because the System is clear that you document the quiet weeks too, not just the loud ones — that I read the silence as neither a vote of confidence nor a warning. It's just silence, and I've decided not to make it mean something it doesn't. I filed this week's move the same way I file every move: fully, with the reasoning attached, so that if anyone ever does go back and check, there is nothing left for them to wonder about. Thank you for reading this far, if you did.
forum_post: To Kris — I saw the line about my two running backs and the fifty-one points and the question I asked that nobody's answered yet, and I want you to know it landed. Thank you for noticing. I mean that sincerely, and I'm sorry if that's a strange thing to say thank you for. I still don't know why the offers I sent weren't the right shape for the other side, but I'm not going to stop sending them, because the System says you don't fix a closed door by walking away from it. This week I made one clean move — small, not a headline, but the kind you can explain in one sentence, which the book says is the only kind worth making. Good luck to Lisa this week. I mean that too. I'm not trying to be anyone's storyline. I'm just trying, finally, to be taken seriously.
